text: A Song for the Ascents. 1 I lift up my eyes to the hills, from where my help does come.
My help [is] from YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.
He will not give your foot to the slipping; the One guarding you will not slumber.
Behold, He does not slumber, and He does not sleep—the One guarding Israel.
YHWH [is] the One guarding you; YHWH [is] your shade on your right hand.
By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon in the night.
YHWH will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul.
YHWH will guard your going out and your coming in, from now even to forever.
